Bug_Title: Synchronization should not be done on instances of value-based classes
Bug_Explanation: The bug is demonstrated by synchronizing on an Integer object, which is a value-based class. Instances of such classes might share the same reference in memory, leading to incorrect synchronization between threads.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method which creates two threads that attempt to synchronize on the same Integer object. Since Integer is a value-based class and can have shared references, this leads to incorrect synchronization and potential race conditions or deadlocks.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results indicate that the test executed successfully without any errors or deadlocks, which suggests that the bug was not triggered during the test run.
